text: dsh-bsk-daemon 管理 DSH 中 BrowserSkill 守护进程的生命周期，提供状态、初始化、唤醒和停止工具，并可在浏览器工具运行前预热 bsk。Windows 上它构建唤醒 shim 并注册无触发器的计划任务，让 daemon 按需启动；macOS 和 Linux 使用分离进程。适合希望 BrowserSkill daemon 按需运行的 DSH 用户。需要本机 bsk CLI；Windows 初始化使用系统任务计划程序和 shim 编译器，不需插件 API key。

dsh-bsk-daemon manages BrowserSkill in DSH with status, setup, wake, and stop tools. It can wake bsk before browser calls. Windows uses a shim and scheduled task; macOS and Linux use a detached process. Requires the local bsk CLI; no API key.
想让 DSH 里的 BrowserSkill 守护进程用到时再启动、空闲后退出
浏览器自动化第一次调用失败时，怎么检查 bsk 是否运行并把它唤醒？
Keep the local BrowserSkill daemon asleep when idle and start it when browser automation needs it.
dsh-bsk-daemon 的功能「状态与维护」：bsk_status 查看 daemon、浏览器、shim 和计划任务状态；bsk_setup 重建 shim 并注册任务，bsk_stop 可立即停止 daemon。
dsh-bsk-daemon 的功能「按需唤醒」：bsk_wake 在 daemon 未运行时启动并等待就绪；启用 autoWake 后，插件也会在 bsk 工具执行前尝试唤醒。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · dsh-bsk-daemon：**Make [BrowserSkill](https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill)'s `bsk` daemon start on demand and exit when idle inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — and fix the Windows `os error 5` that stops it from starting at all.**

[](https://github.com/like999888999-ui/dsh-bsk-daemon/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:like999888999-ui/dsh-bsk-daemon
```

dsh-bsk-daemon README · The problem：`browser-skill` drives a local `bsk` daemon. Either that daemon stays resident forever (wasting a few hundred MB) or `bsk` starts it on demand. The on-demand path is **broken inside DSH on Windows**:

```
automatic daemon startup failed: cannot start an independent Windows daemon;
the host may prohibit Job Object breakaway; ...
Access is denied. (os error 5)
```

dsh-bsk-daemon README · The problem：The DSH host runs inside a Windows **Job Object** that forbids detached children. The very first browser tool call therefore fails, with no hint about what went wrong or how to fix it.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · How it works：A scheduled task is the one process shape that can escape the host's Job Object: tasks are spawned by `taskeng`, not by the host. This plugin puts a tiny wake shim in front of `bsk` and lets a trigger-less scheduled task own the daemon.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[browser tool call] --> B["bsk-shim.exe"]
    B -->|daemon up| C[bsk daemon]
    B -->|daemon down| D["schtasks /run bsk-daemon"]
dsh-bsk-daemon README · How it works：The result: **nothing resident while idle, automatic start when used, automatic exit after the idle timeout.**
dsh-bsk-daemon README · Quick start：```sh
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 1. this plugin：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:like999888999-ui/dsh-bsk-daemon
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 2. browser-skill, if you have not installed it yet：dsh plugin --profile desktop add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin
section: 2. browser-skill, if you have not installed it yet

text:
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 3. fully quit dsh and start it again：```

The first load runs setup once: it builds the shim and registers the scheduled task. Then point `browser-skill` at the shim — add this to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: browserskill
  config:
    bskPath: 'C:\Users\<you>\.local\bin\bsk-shim.exe'
```

Restart the host. Every browser tool call now handles the daemon lifecycle transparently.
section: 3. fully quit dsh and start it again

text: dsh-bsk-daemon README · 3. fully quit dsh and start it again：> **Don't want to touch `bskPath`?** Leave it alone and call `bsk_wake` once before a batch of browser work. Same effect, one extra step.
section: 3. fully quit dsh and start it again

text:
dsh-bsk-daemon README · Verify it worked：Ask the agent to call `bsk_status`. A healthy install returns:

```json
{
  "platform": "win32",
  "strategy": "windows-task",
  "bskExists": true,

`running: false` while idle is **correct** — that is the whole point. Trigger a browser call and it becomes `running: true` with a `pid`.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| :-- | :-- |
| `bsk_status` | Daemon state, connected browsers, shim and task status |
| `bsk_setup` | Rebuild the shim and re-register the task (idempotent; run after upgrading `bsk`) |
| `bsk_wake` | Start the daemon if down and wait until it answers |
| `bsk_stop` | Stop now instead of waiting out the idle timeout |
dsh-bsk-daemon README · Configuration：Set in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under `id: bsk-daemon`, or from the settings page.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `bskPath` | empty (auto-detect) | Path to the `bsk` binary. Empty tries `~/.local/bin/bsk.exe`, `~/.cargo/bin/bsk`, then `PATH` |
| `taskName` | `bsk-daemon` | Scheduled task name |
| `daemonIdle` | `15m` | How long the daemon stays alive while idle |
| `sessionIdle` | `5m` | Per-session idle timeout |
| `autoSetup` | `true` | Run setup once at plugin load |
| `autoWake` | `true` | Pre-warm the daemon before a browser tool runs |
| `shimPath` | empty (`~/.local/bin/bsk-shim.exe`) | Where to build the shim |

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: bsk-daemon
  config:
    daemonIdle: 30m
    autoWake: false

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Platform notes：| Platform | Wake mechanism | Why |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Windows | Scheduled task + shim | Job Object restriction makes a detached spawn impossible |
| macOS / Linux | Plain detached process | No restriction, no shim needed |

On non-Windows platforms the plugin only provides the status and lifecycle tools; no shim or task is created.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · The plugin is loaded but none of the `bsk_*` tools exist：This was a real bug in `0.1.0`, fixed in `0.1.1`. A plugin that calls `ctx.tools.register` **must** declare the service in `inject`:

```js
export const inject = ['tools']
```

Without it the host mounts the plugin before the tool registry exists, `ctx.tools` is `undefined`, and every registration throws inside `apply()`. Because the mount path swallows plugin errors, the plugin still reports as loaded — it just exposes zero tools and no error. Any plugin registering tools is subject to this.
section: The plugin is loaded but none of the `bsk_*` tools exist

text: dsh-bsk-daemon README · `os error 5` / `Access is denied` on the first browser call：Either the shim is not wired up (`bskPath` still points at `bsk.exe`), or the scheduled task is missing. Run `bsk_setup`, then check `bsk_status` reports `shimExists: true` and `taskExists: true`.
section: `os error 5` / `Access is denied` on the first browser call

text: dsh-bsk-daemon README · The daemon never exits：Something else is holding a session open. Check `bsk_status` → `browsers[].session_count`; a stale session keeps the daemon alive until `sessionIdle` elapses.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · `csc.exe` not found during setup：The shim is compiled with the in-box .NET Framework compiler. On a stripped Windows install you may need the .NET Framework developer pack. This is build-time only — an already-built shim is a standalone exe.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Manual shim build (without the plugin)：```sh
git clone https://github.com/like999888999-ui/dsh-bsk-daemon
cd dsh-bsk-daemon
node lib/shim/build-shim.mjs --bsk "C:\Users\you\.local\bin\bsk.exe" --task bsk-daemon
```

Then register the task yourself, or let the plugin do it.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Requirements：- Node.js ≥ 22.13.0
- The `bsk` CLI — see the [BrowserSkill quick start](https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill#quick-start)
- On Windows, the in-box .NET Framework compiler `csc.exe` (present on Windows 8 and later; nothing to download)

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-bsk-daemon
schtasks /Delete /TN bsk-daemon /F
```

You can also delete `bsk-daemon-launch.vbs` and `bsk-daemon.xml` from `~/.bsk/`.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Development：The plugin has **no runtime dependencies** — `lib/index.js` imports only Node
built-ins plus `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, which ships with the dsh host and has a
local fallback (`lib/schema-fallback.js`) for when it is absent. So there is
nothing to `npm install`.

```sh
npm run check   # syntax-check both entry files
npm test        # check + the full unit suite
node --test     # the suite alone
```

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Development：CI runs the suite on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS against Node 22 and 24, and
separately compiles the shim on a clean Windows image. See
[`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml).

Because the shim is C# compiled by the in-box `csc.exe`, its build is exercised
in CI rather than unit-tested — a shim that compiles is the only meaningful
assertion.

Release history is in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-bsk-daemon README · Limitations：- **Windows-specific problem.** On macOS and Linux this mechanism is unnecessary — harmless, just unused.
- **Cold start costs ~4–8 s.** The first call after the daemon exits waits for it to come up. Subsequent calls in the same window are effectively free.
- **`csc.exe` is a build-time dependency only.** Once built, the shim is a standalone exe.
- **Does not install the browser extension.** BrowserSkill's Chrome/Edge extension must be installed from the store by hand — browsers do not allow programmatic extension installs.

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 它解决什么问题：`browser-skill` 插件驱动一个本地 `bsk` 守护进程。这个进程要么常驻（吃掉几百 MB 内存），要么在需要时由 `bsk` 自己拉起。而后者在 **DSH 的 Windows 宿主里是坏的**：

```
automatic daemon startup failed: cannot start an independent Windows daemon;
the host may prohibit Job Object breakaway; ...
拒绝访问。 (os error 5)
```

原因是 DSH 宿主进程被包在 Windows **Job Object** 里，子进程不允许脱离。于是你第一次调用浏览器工具就直接失败，而且报错里完全看不出该怎么修。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 它怎么做的：计划任务是唯一能逃出宿主 Job Object 的进程形态：任务由 `taskeng` 派生，不归宿主管。本插件在 `bsk` 前面垫一个极小的唤醒 shim，并让一条**无触发器**的计划任务持有守护进程。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[浏览器工具调用] --> B["bsk-shim.exe"]
    B -->|守护进程在跑| C[bsk 守护进程]
    B -->|守护进程没跑| D["schtasks /run bsk-daemon"]

结果：**平时不占内存，用到时自动起来，用完按空闲超时自己退出。**
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 快速开始：```sh
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 1. 装本插件：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:like999888999-ui/dsh-bsk-daemon
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 2. 装 browser-skill（如果还没装）：dsh plugin --profile desktop add @wxg-prc-cpg/browser-skill-dsh-plugin

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 3. 完全退出 DSH 再打开：```

首次加载会自动执行一次 setup：编译 shim、注册计划任务。然后把 `browser-skill` 指向 shim —— 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`）里加：

```yaml
- id: browserskill
  config:
    bskPath: 'C:\Users\<你>\.local\bin\bsk-shim.exe'
```

重启宿主后生效。之后所有浏览器工具调用都会自动处理守护进程的启停。

> **不想动 `bskPath`？** 那就保持原样，在每轮浏览器操作前先调用一次 `bsk_wake`。效果一样，只是多一步。
section: 3. 完全退出 DSH 再打开

text:
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 确认装好了：让 agent 调一下 `bsk_status`。健康状态下会返回：

```json
{
  "platform": "win32",
  "strategy": "windows-task",
  "bskExists": true,

空闲时 `running: false` 是**正常的** —— 这正是本插件的目的。发起一次浏览器调用后它会变成 `running: true` 并带上 `pid`。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 提供的工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
| :-- | :-- |
| `bsk_status` | 守护进程状态、已连接的浏览器、shim 与计划任务状态 |
| `bsk_setup` | 重新编译 shim 并注册计划任务（幂等；升级 `bsk` 后运行） |
| `bsk_wake` | 守护进程没跑就启动，并等它就绪 |
| `bsk_stop` | 立即停掉，不等空闲超时 |

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 配置：写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（`id: bsk-daemon`），或用设置页。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `bskPath` | 空（自动探测） | `bsk` 可执行文件路径。留空依次试 `~/.local/bin/bsk.exe`、`~/.cargo/bin/bsk`、`PATH` |
| `taskName` | `bsk-daemon` | 计划任务名 |
| `daemonIdle` | `15m` | 守护进程空闲多久退出 |
| `sessionIdle` | `5m` | 单会话空闲超时 |
| `autoSetup` | `true` | 加载时自动执行一次 setup |
| `autoWake` | `true` | 浏览器工具执行前自动预热守护进程 |
| `shimPath` | 空（`~/.local/bin/bsk-shim.exe`） | shim 输出位置 |

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 配置：```yaml
- id: bsk-daemon
  config:
    daemonIdle: 30m
    autoWake: false

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 平台差异：| 平台 | 唤醒方式 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Windows | 计划任务 + shim | Job Object 限制，必须绕 |
| macOS / Linux | 普通分离进程 | 无此限制，不需要 shim |

非 Windows 平台本插件只提供状态与生命周期工具，不做 shim 与计划任务。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 插件加载了，但一个 `bsk_*` 工具都没有：这是 `0.1.0` 的真实 bug，已在 `0.1.1` 修复。凡是要调 `ctx.tools.register` 的插件，**必须**在 `inject` 里声明所需服务：

```js
export const inject = ['tools']
```

不声明的话，宿主会在工具注册表就绪之前挂载插件，此时 `ctx.tools` 是 `undefined`，`apply()` 里每次注册都抛错。而挂载路径会吞掉插件异常，所以插件仍显示为「已加载」—— 只是工具全没了，且没有任何报错。所有注册工具的插件都会踩这个坑。
section: 插件加载了，但一个 `bsk_*` 工具都没有

text: dsh-bsk-daemon README · 第一次浏览器调用报 `os error 5` / `拒绝访问`：要么 shim 没接上（`bskPath` 还指着 `bsk.exe`），要么计划任务丢了。跑一次 `bsk_setup`，然后用 `bsk_status` 确认 `shimExists: true`、`taskExists: true`。
section: 第一次浏览器调用报 `os error 5` / `拒绝访问`

text: dsh-bsk-daemon README · 守护进程一直不退出：有别的东西还占着会话。看 `bsk_status` 的 `browsers[].session_count`；残留会话会让守护进程一直活到 `sessionIdle` 超时。
dsh-bsk-daemon README · setup 时报 `csc.exe` 找不到：shim 用系统自带的 .NET Framework 编译器编译。精简版 Windows 可能需要装 .NET Framework 开发者包。这属于构建期依赖 —— 已经编译好的 shim 是独立 exe，不再需要它。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 手动编译 shim（不装插件）：```sh
git clone https://github.com/like999888999-ui/dsh-bsk-daemon
cd dsh-bsk-daemon
node lib/shim/build-shim.mjs --bsk "C:\Users\你\.local\bin\bsk.exe" --task bsk-daemon
```

然后自行注册计划任务，或交给插件注册。
section: 手动编译 shim（不装插件）

text:
dsh-bsk-daemon README · 依赖：- Node.js ≥ 22.13.0
- `bsk` CLI —— 见 [BrowserSkill 快速开始](https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill#quick-start)
- Windows 构建 shim 需要系统自带的 .NET Framework 编译器 `csc.exe`（Win8 及以上都有，无需额外安装）

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-bsk-daemon
schtasks /Delete /TN bsk-daemon /F
```

`~/.bsk/` 下的 `bsk-daemon-launch.vbs` 与 `bsk-daemon.xml` 可一并删除。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 开发：本插件**没有运行时依赖** —— `lib/index.js` 只导入 Node 内置模块，外加 dsh 宿主自带的 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`；宿主没带这个包时走本地兜底实现（`lib/schema-fallback.js`）。所以不需要 `npm install`。

```sh
npm run check   # 语法检查两个入口文件
npm test        # 检查 + 完整单元测试
node --test     # 只跑测试
```

CI 会在 Ubuntu、Windows、macOS 三平台、Node 22 与 24 两个版本上跑测试，另外单独在一个干净的 Windows 镜像上编译 shim。见 [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml)。

shim 是 C# 代码、用系统自带的 `csc.exe` 编译，所以它靠 CI 验证而不是单元测试 —— 「能编译出 exe」本身就是最有意义的断言。

版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-bsk-daemon README · 已知限制：- **Windows 专属痛点**：非 Windows 平台这套机制是多余的（但无害）。
- **冷启动约 4–8 秒**：守护进程退出后第一次调用要等它起来。同一窗口内连续使用第二次起几乎无延迟。
- **`csc.exe` 只是构建期依赖**：已经构建好的 shim 是独立 exe，不再依赖。
- **不处理浏览器扩展**：BrowserSkill 的 Chrome/Edge 扩展需你自行从商店安装，浏览器也不允许程序代装扩展。
